assumptions.statement: The deployment pipeline relies on AWS infrastructure (S3, SNS, Lambda) to facilitate artifact transfer between environments.
assumptions.quote: The binary file (artifact) gets stored in an AWS S3 bucket... We have an AWS SNS Topic... We have an AWS Lambda function

assumptions.statement: Artifacts are generated by executing specific Jenkins jobs in the source environment, which triggers the creation of new objects in S3.
assumptions.quote: We create binary artifacts for applications when we execute the **Deploy_App** Jenkins job... This process requires a new object to be created at the source for the mechanism to be triggered

assumptions.statement: The target environment (e.g., Staging) is configured with the necessary AWS resources (S3 bucket, SNS subscription, Lambda function) to receive and process artifacts from the source environment.
assumptions.quote: The **Staging** environment has an AWS S3 bucket... We have an AWS SNS Subscription... We have an AWS Lambda function
